item.description: ByteDance unveiled Doubao Work, a standalone AI office app that taps into Feishu for workplace context, entering a race against Alibaba's Qwen Office, Tencent's WorkBuddy and Kingsoft's WPS Lingxi.

item.description: JD 7Fresh launched its first 24-hour unmanned robot coffee shop in Beijing, setting a Guinness record of 202 cups in an hour, while sparking debate over whether robot cafes can replace human baristas.
